第(1/3)页

“大兄弟，你说要不然咱们降点价呢，现在这镇上也有不少卖竹笼的。”

刘家婶子小心翼翼的说道。

她现在只想赶快把这些竹笼都清出去，不然这么多东西压在这里，她每天看着也着急上火。

一个竹笼可是能卖到五六块钱的，两千多个竹笼，那得是多少钱！

这可不是一个小数了，可不能再压着了。

“不行，绝不能降价。”

“这次降了价，那些人就会觉得拿捏住了我们，之后还会得寸进尺，这个头不能开。”

王建军沉声，斩钉截铁的说道。

想要把竹笼卖出去，他可以想别的办法，但价格绝对不能降。

而且他卖的价格已经很良心了。

市面上比他价格便宜的，没他的竹笼质量好。

要不然那些人也不会要他们降价，而不是直接换人，不就是想要逼他们妥协。

见王建军这么说，那刘家婶子也是急。

“大兄弟，你可得给想个招啊。”

“要不然这么多竹笼堆着，我看大家伙这心里也不踏实，一个个也无精打采的，这样下去可不是个长久的法。”

别说厂里的其她婶子，就连她自己也是慌得很。

要不是王建军的工资没短过她们，怕是她们这些人都要坐不住了。

“你先别急，让我想想，价格肯定是不能降的。”

“既然镇上没市场，那咱们就扩大市场，我就不信好东西还卖不出去了！”

王建军说完，脑海中突然灵光一现，还真让他想到了一个解决办法。

“刘家婶子，麻烦你去镇上找几个人品信得过，又能干的小伙子。”

“我给他们一天开十块钱的工资，还有提成，你问问有没有人愿意来干。”

刘家婶子虽然不知道，王建军这葫芦里卖的什么药，但还是点了点头，答应了下来。

两个人商量着，明天这个点还在这见面，到时候王建军会交代他们做什么的。

心里有了办法，王建军也就沉住气了，骑着摩托车又回了县里。

这次，他没回鲜虾馆。

都这个点了，估计卖的也差不多了，那就晚点再回去吧。

他也该去医院看看他妈了。

"Brother, you said, why don't we lower the price? There are many bamboo cage sellers in this town now."

Aunt Liu said cautiously.

Now she just wants to clear out all these bamboo cages quickly, otherwise she will get angry looking at them every day with so many things pressed here.

A bamboo cage can be sold for five or six yuan, and there are more than two thousand bamboo cages, so how much does that cost?

This is no longer a small number, and it cannot be suppressed any longer.

"No, we must not lower the price."

"With the price reduction this time, those people will feel that they have a hold on us, and they will make further progress in the future. They can't let this go."

Wang Jianjun said in a deep voice and decisively.

If he wants to sell the bamboo cages, he can think of other ways, but the price must not be lowered.

And the price he sells is already very reasonable.

The bamboo cages on the market that are cheaper than his are not as good as his bamboo cages.

Otherwise, those people wouldn't ask them to lower their prices instead of directly replacing them, or they just want to force them to compromise.

Seeing Wang Jianjun say this, Aunt Liu was also anxious.

"Brother, you have to think of a way."

"Otherwise, if there are so many bamboo cages piled up, I think everyone would feel uneasy and listless. This will not be a long-term solution."

Not to mention the other aunts in the factory, even she herself was very panicked.

If Wang Jianjun's salary hadn't been lower than theirs, I'm afraid they wouldn't be able to sit still.

"Don't worry. Let me think about it. The price cannot be lowered."

"Since there is no market in the town, let's expand the market. I don't believe that good things can't be sold anymore!"

After Wang Jianjun finished speaking, an idea suddenly came to his mind, and he really thought of a solution.

"Aunt Liu, please go to the town and find a few young men who are trustworthy and capable."

"I'll give them a salary of ten yuan a day and commission. Ask if anyone is willing to work."

Although Aunt Liu didn't know what kind of medicine Wang Jianjun was selling in this gourd, she still nodded and agreed.

The two people discussed that they would meet here at this time tomorrow, and Wang Jianjun would explain what they were going to do.

With a solution in mind, Wang Jianjun calmed down and returned to the county on his motorcycle.

This time, he didn't go back to the shrimp restaurant.

It’s already at this point, and it’s probably almost sold out, so I’ll go back later.

It's time for him to go to the hospital and see his mother.
